about.title: Chino Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Seven people died in traffic collisions in Chino in 2025, according to public records. Each of those numbers was somebody's parent, partner, or child, and behind each one is a family in San Bernardino County now trying to figure out what comes next. A wrongful death claim is one part of that. It is a civil case, separate from anything the district attorney may pursue, and it exists to hold the responsible party financially accountable for the loss. Chino sees heavy traffic along SR-60, Central Avenue, Riverside Drive, and Euclid Avenue, and collisions here tend to cluster on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. But fatal losses in Chino are not limited to crashes; they can also stem from workplace accidents, medical negligence, or unsafe premises. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm. We connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death claims and works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You decide when you are ready to talk.

whyChoose.title: Why Chino Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death action: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out your family's standing before anything else.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably when a government entity like Caltrans or the City of Chino is involved. Getting connected sooner keeps those options open.

items.title: Every category of loss accounted for
items.desc: Recoverable damages can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Network attorneys work on contingency, so you pay nothing unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash on SR-60 in Chino is still under investigation. Do I have to wait to speak with an attorney?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and runs on its own track, separate from any police investigation or criminal charges. Waiting for a criminal case to finish can eat into the two-year filing window, and evidence from a freeway collision can be harder to gather as time passes. Reaching out early simply gives you information; it does not commit you to anything.

items.question: My father wasn't married when he died. Can his adult children file?
items.answer: Yes. When there is no surviving spouse or domestic partner, children hold the right to bring the claim under California law. If there are no children either, certain financially dependent relatives or heirs may qualify. An attorney can review your specific family situation and explain who should be named in the action.

items.question: What does LawProactive actually do, and what does it cost?

Those attorneys work on contingency, meaning no fee is owed unless there is a recovery, and there is never a charge for using our service.
